description: Localizes every Trellis skill description shown in the `/` slash menu to Chinese across all supported platforms, and stops the release script from sweeping local Claude Code worktrees into the release commit.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(i18n): localize Trellis skill descriptions — `SKILL_DESCRIPTIONS` (start, continue, finish-work, before-dev, brainstorm, check, break-loop, update-spec), the bundled multi-file skills (trellis-meta, trellis-channel, trellis-session-insight, trellis-spec-bootstrap), and the Codex `.codex/skills/*` templates now ship Chinese `description:` frontmatter on every platform (Claude Code, Cursor, Oh My Pi, Pi, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, ...)

**Fixes:**
- fix(release): exclude `.claude/worktrees/` from the pre-release `git add -A` sweep, and gitignore it — 0.6.19 accidentally committed local worktree gitlinks (mode 160000), which broke its npm publish job

**Notes:**
- 0.6.19 was tagged but never published to npm (its publish workflow failed on the worktree gitlinks); 0.6.20 supersedes it and carries both changesets.
notes: Description-only template change: no file renames or deletions. `trellis update` picks up the Chinese descriptions through the normal template diff — unmodified skill files update automatically, locally edited ones go through the usual 3-way merge / conflict path.
